title: Middle Eastern Hazelnut Chicken Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy wrap filled with roasted chicken, crunchy hazelnuts, and creamy tzatziki sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, toast the hazelnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, or until fragrant.
In a small bowl, mix together the tzatziki sauce and chopped parsley.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the tzatziki sauce on the wrap, followed by the sliced chicken, toasted hazelnuts, red onion, cucumber, and a sprinkle of parsley.
